1.t: In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy!

2.t: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the Worlds,

3.t: the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy,

4.t: Master of the Day of Judgement.

5.t: It is You we worship; it is You we ask for help.

6.t: Guide us to the straight path:

7.t: the path of those You have blessed, those who incur no anger and who have not gone astray.
